name: devoxel-engine
description: Devoxel — a pluggable, WebGPU/WebGL Universal Voxel Framework. Storage, meshing, and rendering are each swappable plugins resolved through a central PluginRegistry.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check-deps && npm run lint && npm test

comment_cdnDependencies: This project has no build step: browser code imports dependencies directly from esm.sh instead of node_modules. This field is the single source of truth for that version — run `npm run check-deps` to verify every import site matches it, and update both together when bumping.
